messages:
coastline_pm: Hey @maria — Coastline wants to onboard a custom 7B summarizer trained on receipts + product catalog. Timeline: end of month. Need: no PHI retention, per-request PII redaction, HSM for keys if we go private. Can we do this?

maria: Thanks — high level ok. Can you share the model artifact link and dataset counts? cc @raj for eval plan and @ellen for runtime/ops constraints.

coastline_pm: Link: https://s3.coastline.ai/model-7b-v2.tar.gz
Dataset: ~120k receipts, 30k product pages, sanitized but contains customer emails/phone numbers in some samples. No clinical PHI.

raj: Quick clarifying Qs: 1) Do you require on-prem/private (HSM) at launch, or can you start Hosted then migrate? 2) Target p95 latency / throughput? 3) Any LTV/renewal pressure (SLA biz reasons)?

coastline_pm: Prefer Private w/ HSM from day 1 because legal flagged credential scope. Target p95 latency <= 220ms for 512 tokens. Renewal: yes — renewal tied to latency and error rate SLAs.

ellen: Runtime notes: we support ONNX/torchscript and int8 quantized variants. 7B int8 on A10/A100 meets <250ms p95 typically; T4 might not. We can disable prefix/KV caching per route for PII concerns. Need model spec (input shapes, tokenizer). Also confirm whether you want deterministic sampling / logprobs on responses.

coastline_pm: We'll provide tokenizer + model_spec tonight. We want deterministic sampling for receipts (no creative outputs) and logprobs for QA. Also would like per-request redaction hook before logs persist.

maria: Noted. Two immediate actions: I’ll schedule enablement call and open compliance ticket for HSM/retention. @raj — can you own the eval harness (hallucination, grounding, privacy checks)? Need a 500-sample test set (sanitized) and an initial quality baseline.

raj: I can own it. Plan: create eval deck + harness in Redwood Optimize, add metrics: F1/ROUGE for summary fidelity, hallucination rate, PII residuals score, latency. Propose canary rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on quality regressions.

ellen: Also: for HSM/private deploy we'll need a deployment window and network setup (VPC peering). If you want on-prem, that's a separate onboarding. For retention: we can set audit logs to 1 year, but storage and compliance billing will be extra.

coastline_pm: Budget approved for Dedicated A100 nodes for peak. We'll accept extra storage cost for 1-year logs. We prefer Private (VPC) + HSM.

maria: Great — I'll capture renewal risk: marked HIGH if we miss p95 target by >25% or hallucination rate increases >3% post-rollout. I'll add to account health dashboard.

raj: Next steps from my side: I'll spin up eval runners, request 500 sanitized prompts (please upload to the shared folder), and draft an acceptance checklist. ETA: 48 hours after sample set received.

coastline_pm: Uploading sanitized set to https://files.coastline.ai/safe-samples tonight. Also adding a short acceptance criteria doc.

ellen: Ops: I'll reserve A100 Dedicated capacity for first week of rollout and prepare ONNX quantization guide. Also will open infra ticket for VPC peering.

maria: Scheduling enablement call Thu 11am PT — invite sent. Agenda: intake review, eval plan, rollout schedule, legal signoffs.

coastline_pm: Thanks all. One more ask: legal wants a proof of data-flow redaction working before signing. Can we demo redaction in the enablement call?

maria: Yes — @raj + @ellen can demo a redaction flow + canary route.

raj: Will include: small live demo + test harness run showing PII residuals metric.

deploy-bot: Ticket CS-7894 created: "Coastline 7B private + HSM intake" — assignees: maria, raj, ellen.

coastline_pm: :thumbsup: appreciate the quick turnaround.

maria: Thanks — we'll sync Thu. :calendar:

ellen: Adding a note — if any dataset samples accidentally contain PHI, pause onboarding until legal signs off.

coastline_pm: Understood. We'll sanitize and run internal check first.

maria: Closing loop: I'll update account health and mark renewal risk watch until post-canary.

coastline_pm: Bye for now — will upload tonight.
